test_title: PYST 3: SSC Stenographer - English (Held on: 12 Nov 2021 Shift 1 )
subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate option to substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If no substitution is required, select ‘No substitution’.**

There are adventures to be found in history and art, __not much so__ in bird-watching or skiing.
solution:
The correct answer is option 2) i.e. 'as well as.'

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The error lies in Part (not much so) of the sentence.
 
• According to the rules of conjunctions **'as well as'** is used to add two sentences, two nouns, or two pronouns to emphasize two things equally important.
 
• Here** '****history and art'** and **'bird-watching or skiing'** are nouns in the sentence and they can be joined together with 'as well as.'
 
• Therefore, the use of 'not much so' in the sentence should be replaced with 'as well as' to make it grammatically correct.
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is Option 2.

 

Correct sentence:__* There are adventures to be found in history and art, **__as well as__** in bird-watching or skiing.*
